summary: Pacific Booker Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K acknowledging an unsolicited all-share takeover bid by American Eagle Gold Corp. American Eagle offers 1.41 of its own shares (implied ~$1.59) per Pacific Booker share, representing a ~45% discount to Pacific Booker's $2.90 closing price. The board formed a Special Committee, engaged RCI Capital Group as financial advisor and Laurel Hill Advisory Group as strategic advisor, and expects to file a directors' circular with a formal recommendation. Shareholders are advised to take no action. Watch for the directors' circular and board recommendation; the hostile bid's low premium increases risk of rejection or a competing offer.
